newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: Sulzer places Ebara block of shares.
newsitem.headline: Sulzer places Ebara block of shares.

text.p: Sulzer AG said it had placed 70,000 of its own shares of the block of 110,000 it acquired from Ebara Corp in a transaction that had raised around 30 million Swiss francs.
The other 40,000 have been deposited as cover for call warrants, it said in a statement.
A cross-holding of equity between Sulzer and Ebara ended last December after industrial cooperation the companies envisioned did not materialise, Sulzer said.
Ebara assumed a 66 million Swiss franc convertible bond from Sulzer, which bought the block of 110,000 shares Ebara held.
"In view of favourable price trends on the stock market, Sulzer was able to place 70,000 of these shares directly with various investors as well as on the open stock market," it said.
"This transaction has generated income of around 30 million Swiss francs."
Sulzer also said it had successfully implemented the creation of a single class of shares approved by shareholders.
"So far 99 percent of the 1.1 million Sulzer participation certificates have been converted into an equal number of registered shares," it said.
